campaign.name: And Then the Dragons Came: Purewater
campaign.description: A Classic Fantasy Imperative port of 'And then the Dragons Came', relocated to Purewater -- a Venice-like canal city where the sacred waters of the Lake Lady meet the sea. Baron Hanzo di Teufel arrives with his Dragon Knights for the Lake Lady's Tourney, his possessed champion concealed among them. Four strangers arrive the same week. Built as a living world: every NPC and faction runs its own agenda on a clock, and what the party does not witness happens anyway.
campaign.myth-current-scene: Glass Hounds v2. d6/night, session6. Nimras arrives in Purewater for the FIRST TIME at West Lantern Landing, carrying fellowship introduction to Oren Vey at House of Small Windows, High Isle. Agent-style freelance mage hunter, travelling-magician cover; no alias or state warrant imposed. Nobody in town met yet. Fellowship recovery commission stands; no rooftop hound seen, no surveying episode. Contact and city route-board provide first leads. PC resources unchanged. Play may begin after preparation verification; current player action pending. GM lore myth-lore-9d681319bb7e and glass-hounds-situations-v2.md govern.

acts.title: THE HUNT
acts.for: Introduce a freelance mage hunter arriving in Purewater. Contact Vey, investigate Rennic’s old lodging and contacts, navigate unfamiliar districts and discover competing hunters. A1–A4 offer searches, surveillance, dangerous encounters and a reachable teacher. Earn the glass-hound reveal through pursuit; do not start beside Rennic.
acts.takes: At risk are the teacher's freedom, the manuscript and people in the hunt's path. No injury, capture or escape is predetermined.

acts.title: THE PACK
acts.for: Expose Senn’s coercive capture business and the buyer’s demand for an unwilling living demonstration. B1–B3 offer a hound hunt, maker recovery, workshop infiltration and evidence of the deal. Threats arise from actual enemy knowledge and resources. Allies and city powers can act on earned evidence.
acts.takes: At risk are control of the constructs, custody of useful research and the ability to prevent coercive export. No compulsory betrayal or compensating defeat.

acts.title: WHO KEEPS THE HOUNDS
acts.for: C1–C2 contest loading, an actual captive if one was taken, and Varro’s conditional payment. Settle surviving transport, research, teacher and manuscript. No captive, demonstration, export or payment succeeds by date alone. Early recovery or decisive defeat stands; recalculate the finale from surviving means.
acts.takes: At risk are lasting availability of mage-hunting tools and professional relationships. Clear victory, partial victory, negotiated settlement, failure and withdrawal have distinct concrete results in the GM plan.

pc.name: Nimras
pc.description: Nimras: human Rank 2 Magic-User, freelance mage hunter trained by an independent fellowship. Left amicably to spread his wings. Review draft; not yet in play.
pc.content: Nimras is a freelance mage hunter trained by an independent fellowship. He left on good terms to choose his own work and establish his independence. The fellowship has commissioned him to find his former teacher Rennic Vaur in Purewater and recover an entrusted manuscript. His introduction to Oren Vey is his first proposed lead. He holds no Crown warrant. Alignment and passions remain the player’s choice. No arrival, target sighting or scene has been played.

cfi_rules_notes: Rank 2: base 2 AP +1; base POW Luck 3 + human 1 + Rank 2 table 1 =5.

INT/4 memory fractions rounded down following engine skill guidance.

knows.statement: Nimras arrives in Purewater for the first time at West Lantern Landing during d6/night. His fellowship introduction names Oren Vey at the House of Small Windows, High Isle. He is a freelance mage hunter seeking Rennic alive and the entrusted manuscript; no local warrant or state employment is supplied.
Rennic taught Nimras a warning convention during their earlier work: three chalk strokes under a latch mean an appointment is unsafe. No such mark has yet been observed in Purewater.
Nimras has been commissioned by his former independent fellowship to find Rennic Vaur alive and recover an entrusted manuscript; his first introduction is to Oren Vey.

arrival_brief.name: West Lantern Landing
arrival_brief.world_constraints: Campaign rules: Luck is PC-only; all NPC current/max Luck and rank Luck bonuses are0. Classic Fantasy Imperative combat: repeat initiative cycles while usable AP remain, one proactive Action per TURN not per round. Delay conserves actions, paid when used. Engaged Regain Footing costs1AP and requires opposed Brawn or Athletics; no rank exemption. Nearby dropped weapon recovery costs2Actions (reach then ready). Fightingwhileprone is Formidable. Rank4 CFI AP=2base+2rank=4. Track specific mastery free parries/ripostes distinctly; do not doublecharge them. No free standing or pickup.
arrival_brief.description: Public ferry landing at the edge of the Merchant Quarter, with boat berths, unloading platform and covered route-board.
arrival_brief.staging_notes: SENSE: wet rope, hulls knocking, lamps in canal water. SHAPE: ferry steps to open landing, covered route-board and public footbridge exit; ordinary boat berths. HANDS: mooring post, route-board marking High Isle and House of Small Windows water-stair. COSTS: ordinary public landing; no compulsory fee or confrontation. TURNS: visitors can arrange transport or approach by footbridges. KEY: a new city opens across black water.
